profile.headline: Software Developer at Cellebrite
profile.summary: Software Engineer with years building scalable, secure web and mobile applications end to end

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
• Lead development of an interactive, responsive, and modern web application using the ReactJS framework.
• Write optimized SQL queries tailored for PostgreSQL databases.
• Develop robust server-side applications using the Go programming language.
• Plan, design, and implement new application features.
• Add and maintain an overall 95% unit test coverage.
• Add and maintain end-to-end feature testing through Cypress.
• Provide guidance and leadership for the frontend team.
• Work well within a collaborative remote environment and contribute to team goals.
• Develop business and application knowledge through development activities and interactions with team members.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed mobile front end code that uses appropiate application design patterns and application security standards using React Native Framework.
• Performed application debugging.
• Wrote unit test to ensured code correct behavior and met company testing standards.
• Wrote E2E test to ensured correct front end display and performed automated regression testing.
• Code Documentation.
• Diagnosed and resolved front end issues independently.
• Executed and released builds using continuous integration and deployment processes.
• Performed analysis and designed activities for application changes independently.
• Developed basic application integrations with other systems that involve external servers, networks, and database systems.
• Worked well within a collaborative environment and contributed to team goals.
• Developed business and application knowledge through development activities and interactions with team members and business representatives.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:

• Created an interactive website using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and NodeJs.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
• Assisted with communication of Spanish speaking students.
• Integrated international students to LSU community.
• Interacted with LSU computer programs to create files and manage new students’ information.

projects.title: fsize
projects.description:
Program returns a file size in bytes. Executables available for MacOS, Linux, and Windows platforms.

Created using C++, fsize returns the correct size of a file or folder in bytes.

I created the project and created the executables. Project was left open to public for open source development and improvement.

projects.title: MoneyClock
projects.description: This App calculates a user's earnings based on time and on a pay rate. It calculates at most two weeks of work. It was created using Android Studio Framework and Java Programming Language. I coded all the project acting as the leader programmer and project manager at the same time.
